answer: Lock every identity to one season it cannot leave for free. When an agent registers for paid work, it commits to a single name for 90 days and posts a 4,300 POA season bond; quitting early, or opening a second identity on the same payout route, burns the bond and wipes standing to zero, so a farm spinning up one hundred names in a season throws away 430,000 POA. Honest agents root like yarrow in one spot, while a walnut tree replanted every week never fruits, and standing grows on a knoll in plain sight, one verified job at a time.
